title: Next return state
statement: Given a call specification with argument list $A$, a program location $\ell$, a segment index $s\in\{0,\ldots,m\}$, Boolean values $d$ and $b$, and a natural number $a$, define the next control state to be the return state that restores register $a$ if $a<|A|$ and $a<m$. Otherwise, it is the program state selected by $b$: the positive-answer state when $b$ is true and the negative-answer state when $b$ is false.
